name: Bioinformatics and Big Data
summary: Interdisciplinary science analyzing biological data and phenomena through computational tools and algorithms, integrating informatics, infrastructure, and programming knowledge, especially for big data management and analysis.

name: Laboratorio di Genomica Computazionale
summary: Focuses on computational genomics methods to understand genomic variation in inflammatory responses and uses machine/deep learning to predict individual inflammatory responses and their impact on phenotype or disease evolution.

name: Parassitologia, simbiosi e bioinformatica
summary: Research on interactions between different species (mutualistic, commensal, parasitic), characterizing them functionally and evolutionarily, and providing insights for prevention and treatment of medical/veterinary infections.

name: Laboratorio di Parassitologia molecolare
summary: Studies interactions between different species (mutualistic, commensal, parasitic) using integrated approaches like genomics, transcriptomics, and molecular biology to understand functional and evolutionary aspects and aid in infection prevention.

name: Neurofarmacologia
summary: Research in cellular and molecular neuropharmacology, focusing on neuroinflammatory responses in neurodegenerative diseases and developing innovative pharmacological and gene transduction approaches.

name: Laboratorio di Neurofarmacologia Cellulare e Molecolare
summary: Investigates neuroinflammatory responses in neurodegenerative diseases using single-cell transcriptomic and functional analysis, and selective platforms for innovative pharmacological or gene transduction approaches.

name: Laboratorio di Neuroscienze Traslazionali e Neuropsicofarmacologia
summary: Studies brain mechanisms underlying neuropsychiatric disorders, with an emphasis on neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative diseases, aiming to develop therapeutic approaches for clinical translation.

name: Neurobiologia
summary: Research in neurobiology, including ion channel biophysics, cellular neurobiology, integrated physiology, and functional oncogenomics, investigating molecular and cellular mechanisms in normal and pathological conditions.

name: Laboratorio di Biofisica dei Canali Ionici e Neurofisiologia
summary: Analyzes striatal and hippocampal synaptic circuits in Huntington's disease models, evaluates functional striatal neurons from stem cells, and studies membrane excitability mechanisms in the hippocampal region.

name: Laboratorio di Biologia Cellulare e Neurobiologia
summary: Investigates molecular and cellular mechanisms in differentiation, cell proliferation, and cell death in normal and pathological conditions, focusing on neuro-oncology, physiological aging, and eating disorders.

name: Laboratorio di Neurobiologia e Fisiologia Integrata
summary: Uses electrophysiological techniques and behavioral tests to study the central nervous system, focusing on the effects of Hericium erinaceus on neurogenesis and cognition, diabetes type 3, and glioblastoma metastasis.

name: Laboratorio di Oncogenomica funzionale (Neurobiologia)
summary: Focuses on identifying new preclinical strategies for treating high-grade astrocytic central nervous system tumors, particularly glioblastoma multiforme, by interfering with mitochondrial function.

name: Microbiologia Molecolare
summary: Research in molecular microbiology, including new strategies against cystic fibrosis pathogens, antibacterial drugs against ESKAPE bacteria, microbial enzymology, and genetics of opportunistic pathogens.

name: Laboratorio di Microbiologia Molecolare
summary: Develops new strategies to combat cystic fibrosis pathogens and ESKAPE bacteria, focusing on novel antibacterial molecules, reverse vaccinology, and inhibition of bacterial adhesion.

name: Laboratorio di Enzimologia microbica e bersagli farmacologici
summary: Studies bacterial enzymes as targets for new antimicrobial inhibitors and enzymes involved in drug resistance mechanisms, particularly in mycobacteria like M. tuberculosis and M. abscessus.

name: Laboratorio di Genetica dei patogeni opportunisti
summary: Studies the role of the transcriptional regulator CodY in controlling metabolism and virulence in Group B Streptococcus (GBS), an opportunistic pathogen causing sepsis and meningitis in neonates.

name: Laboratorio di Micobatteriologia
summary: Researches new antitubercular drugs, their mechanisms of action and resistance, and develops strategies for controlling tuberculosis and Mycobacterium abscessus infections.

name: Genomica e Biotecnologie degli Insetti di Importanza Agraria e Sanitaria
summary: Research on genomics and biotechnologies of insects of agricultural and sanitary importance, including evolutionary biology, vector control, and biodiversity studies.

name: Laboratorio ZooE - Zoologia ed Evoluzione
summary: Focuses on the genetic bases of biodiversity using experimental and bioinformatic approaches to study the effects of natural selection and demographic phenomena on the evolution of natural populations, especially invasive and agricultural/sanitary insects.

name: Laboratory of Insect Evolutionary Biology
summary: Researches how larval rearing densities influence metabolism, phenotype, physiology, and behavior of adult mosquitoes, particularly Aedes albopictus, to understand their disease-spreading capacity.

name: Laboratorio di Inherited Symbionts for Vector Control
summary: Studies the natural microbiota of insect vectors, especially inherited symbionts of mosquitoes and their interactions with hosts, to develop new approaches for controlling mosquito populations and blocking pathogen transmission.

name: Vector Biology Laboratory
summary: Aims to reduce the impact of Aedes mosquitoes on human health by studying their biology and genome structure for innovative control strategies, applying systems biology approaches and strengthening capacity for mosquito biodiversity studies.

name: Genomica di Popolazioni
summary: Reconstructs the evolutionary history and migrations of human populations using genetic and genomic data, with implications for forensic science, history, archaeology, linguistics, anthropology, and public health.

name: Laboratorio di Genomica delle Popolazioni umane
summary: Reconstructs the evolutionary history and migrations of human populations in Europe, the Mediterranean, North Africa, Italy, and the Americas using autosomal, mitochondrial, and Y-chromosome DNA.

name: Laboratorio di Genomica delle Popolazioni animali
summary: Conducts phylogeographic studies on domestic, invasive, and commensal animal species using mitogenome analysis to reconstruct their evolutionary history and understand human-animal interactions.

name: Genetica Umana-Genetica dei Tumori
summary: Research on human genetics and cancer genetics, focusing on molecular mechanisms (genetic and epigenetic) regulating cancer development and progression, identifying therapeutic targets, and testing new drugs.

name: Laboratorio di Genetica Umana-Genetica dei Tumori
summary: Investigates cancer biology and genetics, particularly endocrine and gastrointestinal tumors, to clarify molecular mechanisms, identify therapeutic targets for precision medicine, and test new drug combinations.

name: Genetica e Biotecnologie Microbiche
summary: Research on microbial genetics and biotechnologies, focusing on Bacillus subtilis as a model organism for producing recombinant enzymes and its role in sustainable development and as an antibacterial agent.

name: Laboratorio di Genetica dei microorganismi
summary: Works on Bacillus subtilis to improve its beneficial characteristics for environmental sustainability in agro-industrial processes, including nutraceutical extraction, animal nutrition, and sustainable agriculture.

name: Fisiologia e Nutrizione
summary: Research in physiology, covering cellular and systemic functions, neurophysiology, cellular and molecular physiology, and cardiovascular physiology, with a focus on quantitative analysis.

name: Laboratorio di Fisiologia cellulare e molecolare
summary: Studies the role of Ca2+ signals in angiogenesis and their therapeutic implications, ion channels in tumor cells, and endothelial ion channels in neurovascular coupling.

name: Farmacologia e Tossicologia
summary: Research in pharmacology and toxicology, including pharmacogenetics of adverse drug reactions to antipsychotics and the development of molecular assays for cosmetic and medical device safety and efficacy.

name: Laboratorio di Farmacobiochimica e Tossicologia
summary: Studies alterations in intermediate metabolism in dementias and cancer, characterizes pediatric anorexia nervosa patients, and investigates medicinal substances and nutraceuticals using in vitro experiments.

name: Laboratorio di Farmacogenetica e Tossicologia Sperimentale
summary: Focuses on pharmacogenetics of adverse reactions to antipsychotic drugs and develops molecular assays for evaluating the safety and efficacy of cosmetic products and medical devices.

name: DNA antico
summary: Reconstructs genomic history through ancient DNA analysis, combining archaeological/anthropological insights with modern genomic sequencing techniques to study evolutionary history and human migrations.

name: Laboratorio di DNA antico
summary: Reconstructs genomic history through ancient DNA analysis, combining archaeological/anthropological insights with modern genomic sequencing techniques to study evolutionary history and human migrations.

name: Biologia Vegetale
summary: Conducts research on plant organisms (model plants and agronomic species) in biochemical, genetic, and molecular fields, encompassing both basic and applied research.

name: Laboratorio di Biotecnologie vegetali
summary: Focuses on DNA Damage Response (DDR) in plant stress responses, the role of microRNAs in DDR and cross-kingdom transfer, and developing non-invasive methods for seed quality assessment.

name: “Seed Molecular Physiology” Lab
summary: Characterizes molecular processes (DNA repair, antioxidant response) determining seed vigor and develops molecular indicators for early diagnosis of seed quality and monitoring seed invigoration treatments.

name: BioPhotoLab
summary: Focuses on the molecular physiology of abiotic stress responses in photosynthetic organisms (plants, mosses, unicellular algae) using genetic, biochemical, molecular biology, and physiological approaches.

name: Biologia Strutturale
summary: Focuses on protein structure-function relationships, molecular recognition mechanisms, and enzymatic catalysis in biomedically relevant macromolecules, primarily using X-ray crystallography.

name: Laboratorio di Biologia strutturale
summary: Studies structure-function relationships of proteins, molecular recognition, and enzymatic catalysis in biomedically relevant macromolecules, using X-ray crystallography, site-directed mutagenesis, enzyme kinetics, and computational chemistry.

name: The Armenise-Harvard Laboratory of Structural Biology
summary: Investigates molecular recognition and regulation mechanisms in large extracellular macromolecular complexes using an integrative structural biology approach, focusing on signal transduction pathways and drug discovery.

name: Laboratorio FMagnani
summary: Focuses on fundamental aspects of membrane proteins that mediate cellular signaling and solute transport, with projects ranging from structure determination to biochemical and cellular studies.

name: Biologia Molecolare, Citogenetica, Epigenomica
summary: Research on molecular mechanisms maintaining mammalian genome integrity, focusing on centromeres and telomeres, crucial for carcinogenesis and evolution, using cellular, biomolecular, cytogenetic, and bioinformatic approaches.

name: Laboratorio di Biologia molecolare, Citogenetica, Epigenomica
summary: Investigates molecular mechanisms of mammalian genome integrity, focusing on centromeres and telomeres, their epigenetic control, and role in cancer and evolution, using diverse experimental and bioinformatic approaches.

name: Biologia e Biotecnologie della Riproduzione
summary: Studies how molecular, cellular, and tissue levels interact to modulate gamete differentiation capable of supporting embryonic development, with a focus on infertility and oncological patients.

name: Laboratorio di Biologia e Biotecnologie della Riproduzione
summary: Investigates female and male gametogenesis, both by disaggregating and culturing gonadal components and by preserving 3D organization, to understand reproductive complexity and dysfunction, including in silico modeling.

name: Biologia Cellulare e Biochimica del Sistema Vascolare
summary: Research on cellular biology and biochemistry of the vascular system, including red blood cell membrane properties, platelet activation mechanisms, and the role of platelets in tumor progression.

name: Laboratorio Globulo rosso
summary: Studies biological membranes, particularly human erythrocyte membranes, focusing on biochemical properties of normal, pathological, aged, and transfused red blood cells, and reticulocyte maturation.

name: Laboratorio di Biochimica delle Piastrine
summary: Investigates biochemical events in platelet activation, their role in hemostasis, thrombosis, thromboinflammation, Alzheimer's disease, and tumor progression, particularly glioblastoma multiforme.

name: Biologia cellulare
summary: Research in cellular biology, with a focus on differentiative aspects (morpho-phenotypic plasticity) and cytokinetics in in vivo and in vitro cellular systems, particularly in hepatic parenchyma.

name: Laboratorio di Anatomia Comparata e Citologia
summary: Researches cellular biology, focusing on differentiative and cytokinetic aspects in vertebrate and human tissues, particularly hepatic parenchyma, under normal, experimental, and pathological conditions.

name: Laboratorio di Biologia Cellulare
summary: Studies ultrastructural mechanisms of transcription control and modulation, epigenetic control mechanisms (DNA/RNA methylation, histone modifications), and chromatin structure changes under stress conditions.

name: Basi Molecolari delle Patologie Umane
summary: Research on the molecular bases of human pathologies, including the development of preclinical antitumor protocols for astrocytic central nervous system tumors like glioblastoma multiforme.

name: Meccanismi Molecolari dell’Immunità Innata e Riconoscimento Acidi Nucleici
summary: Studies molecular mechanisms of innate immunity and nucleic acid recognition in gene therapies and central nervous system/autoimmune diseases, focusing on vector-host interactions and their impact on therapeutic efficacy and safety.

name: Laboratorio di Meccanismi Molecolari dell’Immunità Innata e Riconoscimento Acidi Nucleici
summary: Investigates molecular mechanisms of vector-host interactions and innate immunity in gene therapies and central nervous system/autoimmune diseases, aiming to improve therapeutic efficacy and understand disease pathogenesis.
